single_factor: representation of the 3 geo columns: one-hot blocks replaced by 9 hierarchical target-encoding features (te1, te3, cnt per level); everything else identical to each family's one-hot baseline

te.formula: te_L = (n_L * rate_L + m * parent_L) / (n_L + m); parent_geo1 = training global class rate; parent_geo2 = smoothed geo1 value; parent_geo3 = smoothed geo2 value; cnt_L = log1p(n_L)
te.unseen: n=0 -> te equals the parent value, cnt = 0

inner_oof.on: outer training-fold labels only; statistics, global prior and counts from the inner-training part only

te.validation_encoding: statistics from the full outer training fold

arms.LR_TE: experiments.age995.run.make_pipeline('C') with the geo one-hot replaced by the 9 TE features -> StandardScaler (fit on the training fold; column-wise, so equivalent to adding them to the numeric scaler while keeping the numeric path byte-identical); text categoricals one-hot; LogisticRegression lbfgs C=1 max_iter=1500 tol=1e-4 random_state=42; threadpool_limits(1)
arms.LGBM_TE: make_pipeline('C')['preprocess'] (scaled numeric + binary + age_is_995, as T4/T8 arm O) with the geo one-hot replaced by the 9 unscaled TE features; text categoricals one-hot; CSR float32; LGBMClassifier(T4 LGBM params, n_jobs=2); threadpool_limits(2)

control_check.kind: TE implementation checks on a stratified ~5k-row development subsample (80/20 stratified split of the subsample) + a tiny synthetic hierarchy; two sample smoke fits (LR_TE, LGBM_TE) on the 4k-row subsample training part; not study fits

primary_metric: unweighted mean of five fold Macro F1 (labels 1,2,3)

generalization_candidate.fold_win: TE fold Macro F1 strictly greater than its baseline on the same fold
generalization_candidate.label: generalization candidate

baseline_challenger.label: baseline challenger candidate (needs separate pre-registered confirmation; no holdout, no final-model change)

rules.geo1_scheme: descriptive only (all geo levels unseen in validation -> TE reduces to the training global prior)
rules.claims: two TE arms on the same folds -> optimistic if selecting; no significance claims, no causal claims
